cohort: 50 pregnant women in their third trimester with cardiovascular disease (New York Heart Association class 2 or higher).
finding: Elevated NT-proBNP levels were significantly associated with increased hypertension during pregnancy (second and third visits) and low neonatal Apgar scores.
mod_finding: No significant differences were found regarding mode of delivery.
followup_time: N/A (outcomes assessed during pregnancy and at birth)
